pr_title: Fetch and print all Issue labels
pr_comments: Also, would be nice fetch and print all PR labels.

issue_context.title: Columns truncated when printing nontty table
issue_context.body:
The table printer is truncating columns (at least in `issue list`) to meet the terminal width even
when invoked non-interactively. This breaks grep-based scripting for, say, long lists of labels.
comments: @vilmibm I was unable to reproduce this with the latest version, is it possible this bug has been fixed?
I'm able to reproduce still; try `gh issue list -L200 | cat` and look for issue 1314. my terminal is 106 columns wide (as per `tput cols`)

It looks like we fetch only maximum of 3 labels per issue and append an ellipsis if there are more labels 
https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/4a8ab49cf1d23c76d77a7cb69537b2bc66769afa/api/queries_issue.go#L81-L86
https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/4a8ab49cf1d23c76d77a7cb69537b2bc66769afa/pkg/cmd/issue/shared/display.go#L61-L62

I guess the fix would be to make sure all labels are fetched and printed in machine-readable mode!
I opened a PR based on suggestions from @mislav . Does cli have a output format flag or implementation? Maybe `gh issue list --format=json` is better for this?

review_comments: I think 100 labels is a bit excessive, what about setting this to 25 for now?

I think 100 is same as saying fetch all labels in GitHubs graphql api. I wouldn't expect labels to be that large anyways, and I noticed use of 100 in other parts of code querying labels. Better to keep at 100
